title: GenAI Engineer
description: Company DescriptionVitol is a leader in the energy sector with a presence across the spectrum: from oil through to power, renewables and carbon. From 40 offices worldwide, we seek to add value across the energy supply chain, including deploying our scale and market understanding to help facilitate the energy transition. To date, we have committed over $2 billion of capital to renewable projects, and are identifying and developing low-carbon opportunities around the world.Our people are our business. Talent is precious to us and we create an environment in which individuals can reach their full potential, unhindered by hierarchy. Our team comprises more than 65 nationalities and we are committed to developing and sustaining a diverse work force. Learn more about us here.Job DescriptionWe are looking for a motivated and technically curious AI Engineer to join our AI team on a full-time, permanent basis. This is a hands-on, build-first role where you will work directly with end-users and internal stakeholders to design and deploy LLM-based automation solutions that create real commercial value.You will be embedded in a small, high-impact team of experienced practitioners who are pushing the boundaries of AI in the energy and commodities sector. From day one, you will build agentic workflows, develop AI Skills and MCPs using leading frontier models, and engage directly with business users to understand their needs and translate them into working solutions.This role expects active ownership from day one: you will be accountable for your deliverables and expected to drive delivery and operate with a high level of autonomy.Key Responsibilities Collaborate with end-users across trading, operations, and support functions to identify automation opportunities and develop LLM-based solutions tailored to their workflows Design, prototype, and iterate on agentic AI workflows that solve real business problems Develop production-ready prompts, AI Skills, and MCPs Engage regularly with stakeholders to gather feedback and refine solutions Translate business problems into clear technical requirements, solution designs, and delivery plans to build, integrate, and deploy solutions Contribute to the team's shared knowledge base and document your work clearlyWhat You'll Gain Commodities & finance: Work at the heart of one of the world's largest energy and commodities trading companies, including oil, gas, metals, and shipping markets Practical AI in finance: Shape how AI is applied for automation, decision support, and commercial advantage in a fast-paced trading environment Agentic systems: Build directly with cutting-edge agentic frameworks and access to frontier model capabilitiesQualifications A degree in a technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related), with 3 to 5 years of professional experience in software, data, or AI engineering Fluency in Python: Ability to write clean, modular, well-documented code, with strong understanding of engineering best practices Familiarity with AI and LLMs: you understand how language models work and have built with them, including hands-on experience with prompting and agentic patterns (tool use, function calling, or MCP) Familiarity with Git and version control workflows Familiarity with Docker, containerisation concepts Exposure to modern full-stack development practices Strong ability to engage with and understand the needs of non-technical end-users Clear communicator who asks good questions and quickly picks up new domains Curiosity for emerging AI developments, with a proactive commitment to continuously learning, experimenting and expanding your skills Intellectual curiosity about commodities markets, global energy flows, and the commercial dynamics of trading; willingness to develop deep domain knowledge as part of the rolePreferredAdditional Information Independent and self-organised, able to manage your own time and priorities with minimal oversight Prior experience building products or experience with, or interest in quantitative finance and derivative markets Prior work on LLM evaluations (evals) or model benchmarking is a plusAdditional Information You will work in a flat, title: Senior AI Agent Engineer - AI Agent Development Section, Business Support Development Department (BSD)
description: Job DescriptionBusiness OverviewRakuten is one of the leading E-commerce companies in the world. Our mission is to empower people and society through the internet while aiming at becoming the "Global Innovation Company."Department OverviewThe Business Support Development Division (BSD) plays a crucial role in supporting various business operations that occur between users, clients, and Rakuten businesses from a systems perspective. Our division provides diverse services across four key domains: DATA, Business Support/Accounting, CRM, and AI Agent, which builds the foundation for leveraging AI across the entire Rakuten organization. We are committed to pursuing business process optimization and efficiency while delivering high value through our system offerings.AI Agent Development Section, established under BSD in January 2026, is dedicated to building next-generation AI agent frameworks that empower Rakuten’s diverse business units through AI technology.Our mission is to reshape the digital future of e-commerce by building AI-native solutions that empower Rakuten merchants, catalyze new revenue growth, and radically reduce operational costs.Our main goal is to unify Merchant Communication ServicesConsolidating fragmented communication services into a single, cohesive merchant interface to streamline communication and user experience.PositionWhy We HireWe are looking for an AI Agent Engineer to design and build autonomous AI systems that can perform complex tasks by interacting with tools, APIs, and environments. You will be at the forefront of AI development, moving beyond simple chatbots to create intelligent agents that drive business value.Position DetailsDesign and develop autonomous AI agents using LLMs and agentic frameworks.Build tool-use capabilities (Function Calling) for agents to interact with external systems and databases.Optimize agent workflows for reasoning, planning, and task execution accuracy.Evaluate and refine agent performance through rigorous testing and prompt engineering.Work EnvironmentMandatory Qualifications・ 7+ years of hands-on experience in web application design, code reviews, performance tuning, and architectural improvements.・ 7+ years of experience in application development with a focus on database schema design and integration with external systems.・ Extensive hands-on experience (7+ years) in the design and development of Web APIs.・ 7+ years of experience in the development and operation of large-scale systems using Java (Spring Boot)・ Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or Microsoft AutoGen.・ Understanding of Prompt Engineering and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning techniques.・Professional working proficiency in Japanese or higher.Desired Qualifications・ Experience of management for large scale projects・ Experience in evaluating agent performance using automated testing frameworks.・ Knowledge of LLM performance optimization (latency reduction, cost management).Other InformationAdditional information on LocationTokyoAdditional Information On English Qualification・ TOEIC score of 800+ or equivalent business-level English proficiency.#engineer #commerce #RakutenIchiba Show more Show less

title: Senior AI Engineer
description: Senior AI EngineerAbout ChubbChubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is distinguished by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength, underwriting excellence, superior claims handling expertise and local operations globally.About the TeamWe are a fast-moving team delivering AI scalability and governance solutions across Chubb's product portfolio. Engineers work across multiple products, own everything they touch from start to finish, and are expected to rise to the challenges their work demands. We build AI-native, move with purpose, and value engineers who bring both hard work and sound judgment to complex problems.About the RoleWe are looking for an AI Engineer who has shipped ML and LLM systems, built quality and observability tooling around them in production, and is ready to go deeper on that problem at scale. In this hands-on role, you will take end-to-end ownership of individual services within a larger AI platform, covering the architecture, data layer, business logic, and API surface without splitting responsibility across specialisms. You will collaborate with peer engineers to define and hold the integration contracts between services as each piece lands. You will develop iteratively alongside a small team, with short feedback loops and a high bar for what ships.What You Will DoApplication DevelopmentDesign and build production-grade LLM-powered services in Python and Go, integrating with cloud AI APIs such as Azure OpenAI or AWS Bedrock. Take end-to-end ownership of individual services: data model, business logic, and API surface across all layers.Build with LLMs as naturally as with any other system component, integrating them into full application stacks rather than treating them as black-box API calls.Define and maintain integration contracts with peer engineers so independently owned services fit together cleanly as the system grows.Build configuration-driven systems where runtime behaviour is governed by stored configuration rather than code changes. Design and implement event-driven, state-based workflows: configurable lifecycle states, transition logic, and trigger mechanisms as production services.Contribute to containerised deployments using Docker and Kubernetes, following established CI/CD pipelines.Observability & EvaluationBuild and own evaluation harnesses: golden datasets, rubric-based scoring pipelines, regression suites, and experiment comparison frameworks. Instrument LLM call paths end to end including distributed tracing, latency, token usage, and model behaviour at scale.Design recording and data layers that connect live LLM calls to offline quality measurement, making the prompt version, model, and configuration active at decision time fully reproducible.Surface observability signals in dashboards that are actionable for engineers and legible to non-technical stakeholders.Software engineering and design patternsKeep clean separation between business logic and infrastructure; keep abstractions honest and remove them when they stop paying for themselves.Hold a high bar on type safety (Pydantic, typed TypeScript), comprehensive error handling, idempotency, and environment-agnostic configuration.Build for operability from day one: structured logging (structlog), OpenTelemetry tracing, Azure Application Insights, meaningful SLOs, and the instrumentation needed to chase down problems like SSE streaming failures behind ingress or memory-growth patterns under sustained load.Design multi-tenant systems with real access control: hierarchical entitlements and role models, per-user OAuth delegation (MSAL/PKCE), and rate and quota enforcement.Write the design docs. Architecture decisions here get reviewed, argued about, and referenced later.Prompt Integration & GuardrailsImplement and iterate on prompt templates using established patterns including few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured outputs, and function calling.Work with versioned content and configuration as inputs alongside prompts: what a model receives at runtime is often composed from multiple managed sources, not a single template.Manage context windows deliberately through chunking strategy, token optimisation, and retrieval design.CollaborationPlan and track your own work against clear outcomes in agile sprints.Partner with product and senior engineers to translate requirements into working AI features.Communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.What You BringRequired6-8 years building production software, with recent, substantial work on LLM-based systems that real users depend on. Deep experience with Python / Go / Rust and similar languages, building safe, scalable, multi-tenant production systems. Experience with test-driven development as a design discipline, writing tests first rather than retrofitting them.Direct experience with at least one frontier provider SDK (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) at the agent-loop level, not just chat completions. Fluency in software design patterns and the taste to know which problem each one actually solves. Cloud-native delivery; containers, Kubernetes (AKS preferred), CI/CD and production observability. Solid command of LLM behaviour including prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, and context window management.Familiarity with REST APIs and cloud AI services including Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or GCP Vertex AI.Ability to work through ambiguity with stakeholders and turn a vague capability ask into a defensible technical design. Good to haveGoogle ADK, Mastra (including declarative YAML workflows), Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, AutoGen — breadth here is useful, and having formed opinions about where each breaks down is more useful still.Experience across Angular, React, Redis, Nx Monorepos, Cosmos DB / SQL Server.Retrieval systems, vector indexing, and citation grade grounding. Insurance or financial services domain exposure. (underwriting, claims, reinsurance)Experience with LLM observability and tracing tools such as LangFuse or equivalent.How you workYou design with standard software engineering patterns before you code.You research before you commit, and you write down what you found.You prefer production-ready over clever, and you can tell the difference.You give and take direct technical feedback well.You care that the thing works for the person using it, not only that it ran.What we offer in the teamOwnership of platform foundations used across a global organization, not a proof of concept that dies in a demo.A team that treats architecture as a first-class activity and gives engineers room to make calls.Access to frontier models and tooling, and a mandate to figure out what they're actually good for.Chubb Canada does not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assess, screen, or select applicants. At Chubb we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants based on job-related qualifications and ability to perform a job. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process or upon hire, please inform Human Resources. If a selected applicant requests accommodation during the recruitment process, Chubb will consult with the applicant in order to provide suitable accommodation that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs.
